purpose: Freeze how validated P1 run results are transformed into descriptive and comparative metrics without post-hoc metric invention.

primary_metric.name: TOTAL_SYSTEM_TOKENS_PER_VERIFIED_SOLVED_TASK
primary_metric.numerator: sum total-system tokens consumed by all treatment runs in the comparison set, including failed and inconclusive runs when the accounting metric is complete
primary_metric.denominator: count of runs with oracle_result == YES in the same comparison set

secondary_metrics.VERIFIED_SOLVE_RATE: YES / all validly-attributed treatment runs; report INCONCLUSIVE separately rather than silently combining with NO
secondary_metrics.MONETARY_COST_PER_VERIFIED_SOLVED_TASK: sum monetary cost / verified_solved_count when comparable price accounting is available
secondary_metrics.WALL_CLOCK_LATENCY: distribution of ended_at - started_at by treatment and task
secondary_metrics.ESCALATION_RATE: runs with one or more escalation/handoff events / eligible runs
secondary_metrics.RETRY_RATE: runs with one or more retry/replan events / eligible runs
secondary_metrics.FAILURE_RATE: valid PRODUCT_FAILURE outcomes / validly-attributed treatment runs
secondary_metrics.INCONCLUSIVE_RATE: INCONCLUSIVE outcomes / all attempted treatment runs
secondary_metrics.VERIFICATION_TOKEN_SHARE: verification_tokens / total_system_tokens when both are measured
secondary_metrics.CONTROL_OVERHEAD_SHARE: (routing + shaping + planning + escalation + retry + verification tokens) / total_system_tokens when all required partitions are measured

paired_reporting.rule: When the same frozen task has comparable runs across treatments, preserve task pairing in summaries.

distribution_reporting: bootstrap confidence intervals only where justified by sample size/design
prohibitions: no silent imputation of missing telemetry
no dropping expensive failed runs from numerator
no treating provider/harness failure as PRODUCT_FAILURE
no universal superiority claim from S1 smoke or undersized samples
small_sample_rule: Descriptive evidence only; conclusion remains INCONCLUSIVE for broad superiority claims.
